newsitem.title: UK: Lloyd's of London to issue 200 writs today.
newsitem.headline: Lloyd's of London to issue 200 writs today.

text.p: Lloyds of London insurance market said on Thursday that it will today begin legal proceedings against some of its backers, known as Names, to recover an estimated 500 million stg ($781.9 million) in unpaid debts.

Two hundred writs will be issued in the High Court against some of the 1,800 or so Names who have not accepted Lloyd's 3.2 billion stg compensation deal for losses incurred through the market in recent years, a Lloyd's spokesman told Reuters.
More than 32,000 Names have signed up for the settlement package and, in return, agreed to end legal action against Lloyd's and its agents.
The spokesman said he did not know what criteria Lloyd's had used to select the 200 Names who will be sent the first writs.
The amount of money owed to Lloyd's by the 1,800 non-acceptors would have been reduced to around 100 million stg, had they accepted the settlement deal, he added.
-- John Sanders, Reuters Insurance News 44 171 542 2769 ($ = 0.639 British Pounds Sterling)
